headlines.title: Did Visa’s Stablecoin and SAP Pay Push Just Shift Visa's (V) Investment Narrative?
headlines.summary: In recent days, Visa has highlighted its expanding role in stablecoin and blockchain payments, including its TOKEN2049 Singapore appearance and its role in SAP Pay’s embedded stablecoin settlement for multinational corporates, alongside reporting fiscal third-quarter net revenue of US$11.63 billion and net income of US$5.63 billion.

headlines.title: Visa Trades at 24 Times Forward Earnings. Can Payment Growth Justify the Premium?
headlines.summary: Visa Inc. (NYSE:V) keeps gaining from the shift to digital payments, but serving that market now costs more. On October 6, 2026, the stock traded at $369.71 intraday, about 31.5 times reported trailing earnings. The question is whether Visa can keep growing without letting costs eat more of each dollar it earns.

headlines.title: JPMorgan Just Raised Its Dividend 10%. These 4 Stocks Also Can Afford to Pay Much Bigger Dividends
headlines.summary: JPMorgan just handed shareholders a 10% raise, and it barely dented what the bank actually earns. Four other companies sit in the same position, carrying payout ratios low enough to fund aggressive dividend growth for years to come.

description: Visa Inc. operates as a payment technology company in the United States and internationally. The company operates VisaNet, a transaction processing network that enables authorization, clearing, and settlement of payment transactions. It also offers credit, debit, and prepaid card products; tap to pay, tokenization, and click to pay services; Visa Direct, a platform which facilitates money movement, enabling clients to collect, hold, convert, and send funds across its network; and issuing solutions, such as airport lounge access, dining reservations, shopping experiences, event tickets, and seller offers. In addition, the company provides acceptance solutions, an omnichannel payment integration with e-commerce platforms; risk detection and prevention solutions; and advisory and other services comprising consulting practice, proprietary analytics models, data scientists and economists, marketing services, and managed services. It provides its services under the Visa, Visa Electron, V PAY, Interlink, and PLUS brands. The company serves consumers, sellers, financial institutions, and government entities. Visa Inc. was founded in 1958 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
